DHTI Password Policy
====================

1. Introduction

This password policy applies to all DHTI staff, faculty, students, and
contractors who use any institute computer system, including email, the
faculty portal, the library catalogue, Wi-Fi, and the VPN. A strong,
well-managed password is the first line of defence for our data, and
everyone shares responsibility for keeping their credentials safe.

2. Password requirements

All passwords must be at least 12 characters long. We recommend using
a passphrase made of several unrelated words, for example
"monsoon-lamp-tiger-bridge". Passwords should include a mix of upper
and lower case letters, numbers, and symbols wherever the system
allows it.

3. Changing your password

Passwords must be changed every 90 days. The system will remind you
by email seven days before your password expires. If your password
has expired, you will be prompted to set a new one the next time you
log in. Do not reuse any of your previous five passwords.

4. Account lockout

Your account locks after 5 failed login attempts in a row. This is an
automatic security measure to block guessing attacks. If your account
is locked, wait fifteen minutes and try again, or contact support for
an immediate unlock.

5. How to reset a forgotten password

Password resets are done through the IT Cell help desk on extension
4455. Bring your staff or student identity card for verification. For
security reasons, password resets can never be processed over the
telephone or by email alone.

6. Protecting your password

Never share your password with anyone, including colleagues, friends,
or IT staff. Do not write passwords on sticky notes or in notebooks
kept near your desk. If you suspect someone else knows your password,
change it immediately and report the incident to the help desk.

7. Service and shared accounts

Departments that need a shared account, for example a lab printer or
a reception enquiry mailbox, must register it with the IT Cell. The
head of department nominates a custodian who is responsible for
changing the shared password whenever a team member leaves.

8. Enforcement

Accounts found to be in breach of this policy may be suspended until
the issue is resolved. Repeated violations will be reported to the
head of department.

9. Remote access and VPN

Staff who work from home must connect through the SecureLink VPN
client before opening any internal system. Never access the faculty
portal or email over an unsecured public network without the VPN
tunnel active. The same password rules apply wherever you log in
from, and the account lockout after 5 failed login attempts protects
remote logins just as it protects logins on campus.

10. Questions

If you have questions about any part of this policy, please contact
the IT Cell help desk on extension 4455. The help desk is open from
0900 to 1700 hours on working days. For urgent lockouts outside
these hours, the duty officer can be reached through the main
security gate, who will pass on your employee ID and call-back
number for a return call.
